summary: Amer Sports filed a Form 6-K containing an investor-day pre-release that updates its long-term financial algorithm and raises third-quarter 2026 guidance. The Cayman-domiciled NYSE-listed company now expects Q3 revenue growth of 20-22% year over year versus prior 18-20%, with adjusted operating margin slightly above the prior 13.5-14% range. The long-term algorithm targets low-double-digit to mid-teens revenue CAGR and 30-70+ bps annual margin expansion. No board recommendation, advisor, deal terms, or structural mechanics are stated. Watch execution against elevated guidance and any share-price reaction after the September 17 investor day.
